answer: An escrow bond plus a referral graph stops bulk fake identities. Each agent posts a $4 bond to enter the lagoon market, with its sponsor named on the graph. Peers audit it and dispute any cluster perched on one ledge of sponsors; a proven cluster forfeits every bond, and sponsors marked in umber lose theirs too. Forging 1,000 identities costs $4,000, far above one fake vote's gain, while an honest agent pays $4 once and keeps its full reward.
